name: baziche-api
description: Baziche backend — Hono + TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers (D1 + R2)

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply baziche-auth --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply baziche-data --local
scripts.db:create: wrangler d1 create baziche-auth && wrangler d1 create baziche-data
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply baziche-auth --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply baziche-data --remote
